description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the rpg character asset pack workflow: create a roleplaying character asset pack from owned artwork. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_rpg_character_asset_pack with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_rpg_character_asset_pack.
